messages.content: "Can you help me understand the ecological impact of the African Elephant in the Serengeti ecosystem over the last 5 years and also assess the population growth of the same species in the same location over the last 10 years? After that, I would also like to know the ecological impact of the Bengal Tiger in the Sundarbans ecosystem over the last 3 years and assess the population growth of the same species in the same location over the last 7 years."

Then ecological impact of Bengal Tiger in Sundarbans over last 3 years; population growth of Bengal Tiger in Sundarbans over last 7 years.

Then call wildlife_population_assess_growth for African Elephant in Serengeti with duration=10. Then call ecological_impact_analyze for Bengal Tiger in Sundarbans with timeframe=3. Then call wildlife_population_assess_growth for Bengal Tiger in Sundarbans with duration=7.

So we will start with first function call: ecological_impact_analyze for African Elephant in Serengeti timeframe=5. Then after receiving result, we will call next function. But the user asked for all four results. We can do iterative approach: call first function, wait for result, then call second, etc. We'll do it step by step.

Thus first function call: ecological_impact_analyze with species="African Elephant", ecosystem="Serengeti", location="Serengeti", timeframe=5.
